title: Duplicate name checks differ for personal and public groups
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Tag groups tab.
  • An active location is selected.
  • You already own a personal group named "Techs"; a public group named "Techs" exists at the location.
custom_steps:
1. Try to save a second personal group of yours named "Techs".
  2. Try to save a public group named the same as an existing public group.
  3. Switch a personal group to public without renaming it, into a public-name clash.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Saving a personal group whose name matches another group you already own at that location is refused, with the inline Name-field message "You already have a tag group with this name at this location."
  • Saving a public group whose name matches another public group at that location is refused, with "A public tag group with this name already exists at this location."
  • The name check runs on create, on rename, and when a group is switched from personal to public without a rename.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-N1: “Saving a personal group whose name matches another group the user already owns at that location is refused, with the inline message on the Name field: "You already have a tag group with this name at this location."”
  • S6-N2: “Saving a public group whose name matches another public group at that location is refused, with the inline message on the Name field: "A public tag group with this name already exists at this location."”
  • S6-N3: “The name check runs on create, on rename, and when a group is switched from personal to public without a rename.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
